description:
Second-in-Command: Auxiliaries

Adds multiple new executive officers, exploration focused milestones as well as some QoL utilities for for the player.

Requires

Second-in-Command

,

LunaLib

Integrated with

LunaSettings

Download

Current version:

1.3.0

Older versions

Executive officers

Enabled

by default

Adds the following XOs to Second-in-Command:

Cadet: Enables the use of Support Doctrine as a full fledged XO, allowing the creation of fleets without the need of officers.Storm: Allows the player to warp in Raptor ships after the battle has started, thereby allowing for both an early game boost and for going above the standard 240 DP limit. Custom sprites made by Khepth!Valkyrie: An alternative to the Strikecraft aptitude, instead focusing on a smaller amount of dedicated fighter wings and its carriers.Apostle: Favored by Ludd's followers and provides an aggressive fighting style as well as providing ways to mitigate the Ill-Advised Modifications hullmod.Nomad: Provides the possibility to restore damaged ships without having to resort to combat when out exploration and can be seen as an alternative to the Starfaring XO.Guerilla: Focused around using a smaller fleet together with hit-and-run tactics to ambush the enemy and hit them hard.Helios: Enhancing the battle carrier doctrine, allowing you to create a sturdy wall of ships with close ranged fighter wings.

See the in-game codex for more information about each executive officer and their spawn locations.

Cadet[close]Storm[close]Valkyrie[close]Apostle[close]Nomad[close]Guerilla[close]Helios[close]

Explorer milestones (non-executive skills)

Enabled

by default

To improve upon the exploration part of the game and give a sense of progression, the mod adds eleven non-executive skills, aka Milestones. These skills generally provides small non-combat bonuses that should hopefully encourage even more exploration.

The player can unlock these milestones by for example beating one of the endgame encounters deep in the Abyss and destroying at least one capital ship, being an honest citizen and paying their taxes or by building up colonies with multiple Megaports.

Additionally by beating the [Redacted], the player gains the possibility to acquire automated ships and can even field a small subset of them (scaled by the Automated Points Multiplier), without having to take a dedicated XO for one of the automation skills.

Explorer[close]

Quality-of-Life utilities

Disabled

by default

Additionally the mod adds the following utilities that the player can enable:

Fleet composition: Adds a couple of more fleet composition counters to the left hand information box in the fleet menu.Fighter primary role: Changes the fighter wings primary role string to each fighters corresponding type, this is purely a UI change to make it easier to identify which wings are Fighters and which are Interceptors etc.

Fleet composition[close]Fighter primary role[close]

Additional information

for making Starsector.

for creating Second-in-Command.

for creating Secrets of the Frontier, lots of inspiration is taken from their InvokeHerBlessing/spawnRosethorn code.

-

Dal:

for creating Quality Perks, lots of inspiration for how to add perks and milestones.

-

for creating Ship Mastery System, lots of inspiration for how to add modifiers to ships.

Unofficial Starsector Discord:

for helpful modding information, tips, ideas and balance discussions.

descriptionHtml:
Second-in-Command: Auxiliaries

Adds multiple new executive officers, exploration focused milestones as well as some QoL utilities for for the player.

Requires Second-in-Command, LunaLib
Integrated with LunaSettings

Download
Current version: 1.3.0
Older versions

Executive officers
Enabled by default

Adds the following XOs to Second-in-Command:
  • Cadet: Enables the use of Support Doctrine as a full fledged XO, allowing the creation of fleets without the need of officers.
  • Storm: Allows the player to warp in Raptor ships after the battle has started, thereby allowing for both an early game boost and for going above the standard 240 DP limit. Custom sprites made by Khepth!
  • Valkyrie: An alternative to the Strikecraft aptitude, instead focusing on a smaller amount of dedicated fighter wings and its carriers.
  • Apostle: Favored by Ludd's followers and provides an aggressive fighting style as well as providing ways to mitigate the Ill-Advised Modifications hullmod.
  • Nomad: Provides the possibility to restore damaged ships without having to resort to combat when out exploration and can be seen as an alternative to the Starfaring XO.
  • Guerilla: Focused around using a smaller fleet together with hit-and-run tactics to ambush the enemy and hit them hard.
  • Helios: Enhancing the battle carrier doctrine, allowing you to create a sturdy wall of ships with close ranged fighter wings.
See the in-game codex for more information about each executive officer and their spawn locations.

aiDescription: Adds several new executive officers including Cadet, Storm, Valkyrie, Apostle, Nomad, Guerilla, and Helios, each with unique abilities. Introduces eleven non-executive exploration milestones to reward exploration and colony building. Includes optional quality-of-life utilities like fleet composition counters and fighter role identification.
